text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we have a hotfix deploy window at 11:30 PDT today for the tokenization bug. Planning to pin frontend -> api v3.1.2-hotfix and model-serving -> model-server:3.1.2-hotfix. Need final RN blurb, internal announce copy, and rollback lanes. @maria can you own RN snippet?
maria: Got it. Drafting a short blurb now — will post in a sec. Do we want to mention the affected endpoints or keep it generic?
alex: short + specific is better. Call out /generate and /chat endpoints, and say it fixes token splitting for certain emoji sequences. Keep customer-facing copy gentle.
tim: For ops: rollback lane A = revert model pin to model-server:3.1.1; lane B = scale down traffic to canary pool and route 100% to standby region. If deploy-bot fails, manual rollback steps are in the Playbook (link).
jen: For internal announcement, suggest: "Hotfix rolling at 11:30 PDT to address emoji tokenization issue impacting some generation outputs. No expected data migration; minor risk of elevated latency during warmup." Short, then link to postmortem template if needed.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by alex at 2026-05-02T18:30:00Z. Canary pool: frontend-canary-2, model-pool: gpu-hotfix-1. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 6172000000`
maria: RN blurb draft: "We're rolling out v3.1.2-hotfix to fix tokenization errors that could cause stray symbols in generated text for some emoji sequences. This is a targeted fix; most customers won't see changes. Expected downtime: none. If you see regressions, please ping #support and tag @eng-oncall." Thoughts?
alex: looks good. Add a short internal note: list owners + rollback instructions. Also pin the RN in the staff digest.
robert-oncall: I'll be on standby during the window. If we hit >2% error rate or latency > 2x baseline for 5m, I'll trigger rollback lane A. Please ensure metrics dashboard has the new alert thresholds.
tim: Quick checklist before deploy: 1) confirm canary health checks passing 2) confirm KV cache priming script ran 3) ensure traffic split configured 10% canary -> 90% baseline 4) alerting enabled.
alex: Can someone paste the exact pin commands we will run? I'll run them during the window.
maria: Pin commands: ```
# API service
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:3.1.2-hotfix -n prod
# Model service
kubectl set image deployment/model-server model-server=redwood/model-server:3.1.2-hotfix -n prod
```
jen: Internal announce short copy ready: "Hotfix rollout (v3.1.2-hotfix) at 11:30 PDT — fixes emoji tokenization for a subset of generation requests. Oncall: robert-oncall. If you see issues, escalate to #eng-oncall. More details: [link to RN]."
alex: Good. Maria, can you post the RN to the internal docs and add the link here? Then I'll kick deploy-bot.
maria: Posted: https://internal/docs/rn/v3.1.2-hotfix. Added owners and full rollback steps.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started at 2026-05-02T18:30:30Z. Canary health checks: 3/3. Traffic split set to 10% canary.
robert-oncall: Monitoring dashboards now show canary latency within 1.1x baseline, error rate 0.1% — all good so far.
tim: Proceed to 50% after 5m if stable, then full rollout. Remember to run the KV priming job between 10%->50%.
alex: Proceeding to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Traffic updated to 50% canary at 2026-05-02T18:36:00Z.
robert-oncall: After priming, small spike in memory usage but within thresh. No errors.
jen: I'll post the internal announcement now using the copy above.
maria: Thanks — RN pinned in staff digest and linked in the announce.
alex: OK rolling to 100%. If anything anomalous, trigger `rollback lane A` and notify here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% completed at 2026-05-02T18:40:10Z. All canaries passed.
robert-oncall: Watching post-rollout metrics for 10m. So far stable.
jen: Announcement posted. Short summary in #general as well.
alex: Great work team. We'll keep this thread for any follow-ups and link to the postmortem if needed. Closing monitoring window in 10m. :white_check_mark:
